variables.name: INTENT_KEY_ICC_STATE
variables.comment: The extra data for broadcasting intent INTENT_ICC_STATE_CHANGE

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ICC_UNKNOWN
variables.comment: UNKNOWN means the ICC state is unknown

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ICC_NOT_READY
variables.comment: NOT_READY means the ICC interface is not ready (eg, radio is off or powering on)

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ICC_CARD_IO_ERROR
variables.comment: CARD_IO_ERROR means for three consecutive times there was SIM IO error

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ICC_CARD_RESTRICTED
variables.comment: CARD_RESTRICTED means card is present but not usable due to carrier restrictions

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ICC_LOCKED
variables.comment: LOCKED means ICC is locked by pin or by network

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ICC_READY
variables.comment: READY means ICC is ready to access

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ICC_IMSI
variables.comment: IMSI means ICC IMSI is ready in property

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ICC_LOADED
variables.comment: LOADED means all ICC records, including IMSI, are loaded

variables.name: INTENT_KEY_LOCKED_REASON
variables.comment: The extra data for broadcasting intent INTENT_ICC_STATE_CHANGE

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_LOCKED_ON_PIN
variables.comment: PIN means ICC is locked on PIN1

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_LOCKED_ON_PUK
variables.comment: PUK means ICC is locked on PUK1

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_LOCKED_NETWORK
variables.comment: NETWORK means ICC is locked on NETWORK PERSONALIZATION

variables.name: INTENT_VALUE_ABSENT_ON_PERM_DISABLED
variables.comment: PERM_DISABLED means ICC is permanently disabled due to puk fails
